markets.question: Who will win in the upcoming football event Indianapolis Colts vs Washington Commanders scheduled for October 4, 2026 at 1:30 PM UTC?
markets.description: This market will settle to the winner of the Indianapolis Colts vs Washington Commanders NFL game scheduled for Oct 4, 2026. Overtime is included if played. If the game ends in a tie, the market will settle to $0.50. If the game is delayed, postponed, or suspended and not rescheduled to a date within two weeks of the originally scheduled date, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from NFL.
